name: @huddle/game-core
description: Game Module interface plus the room and event types every game module and the hub share.
//devDependencies: React is a *type-only* dependency: the Game Module interface types a game's two screens, and a screen is a React component. Nothing in this package imports a value from React, so `@types/react` is the whole of the need and there is no peer dependency on the runtime — a package that never calls React has no business asking a consumer to install it. This is also what keeps game-core runnable under plain Node, which is how the Convex server reads it.
